question: What decision currently governs python multiphase extension init policy? Return the public decision ID and its authority evidence.

claims.text: PEP-489 is the currently active decision governing Python's multi-phase extension module initialization policy.
The authority evidence for PEP-489 is documented in the Python PEPs repository at https://github.com/python/peps/blob/b2120d116aa696f409b4d8333c4020ab8f93c9c7/peps/pep-0489.rst with Final status.
